draft.goal: Matched-raster 4K JPEG/PNG WIC decode and whole-process memory differential under DC-MP-IMG2; no decoder adoption or memory-SLO claim.

tasks.goal: Decode pixel-identical 4K grayscale JPEG and PNG in six fixed serial scenarios, verify exact ROI equality and pre-OnLoad refusal, and record bounded whole-process observations with an independent repeat.

inputs.description: Verbatim W12 directive at docs/development/evidence-published/w12-latest/tern-directive.txt; start head 8cc44ad9a2bb1d6da260cc42c900e2287f5eed07 is the pushed W11 disposition.
DC-MP-IMG2 plus existing W2 worker, W4 ROI, W6 sampler, W7 PNG/4K verification, W8-W11 JPEG fixtures/verifiers and ADR-0009/0013.

constraints.text: Only new w12_* tooling, tests, plan/BUILD_AND_RUN/TESTING and w12-latest evidence. No W2/W4/W6/W7/W8-W11 edits, WIC probe semantics, crates/media, Runtime/GPU/UI, dependencies, unsafe/FFI/COM or product policy.

Reuse the existing W11 4K grayscale JPEG byte-for-byte. New PNG is streamed 8-bit grayscale with the identical DC/block pattern, bounded zlib, exclusive create, never a re-encoding of decoder output. Independent parsers validate JPEG and PNG and prove every input pixel equals the fixed coordinate oracle; failure to prove equality is HOLD.

Limits 4096 dimension, 16777216 pixels, 8 depth, 67108864 decoded/scratch; 16MiB encoded input per fixture, 262144 ROI bytes, 1MiB output, 128MiB work, 8MiB report; six workers per repeat, one at a time, 45s worker/300s batch, 64KiB capture, 128KiB/128-record trace, 768MiB observed private. Keep the W11 owned pending-to-final rename allowance only; forbid other missing/reparse/unknown outputs.

Reuse the W6 sampler at the same after_onload boundary for S01-S04. Each worker is a separate process lifetime; classify OBSERVED_WHOLE_PROCESS_DIFFERENTIAL and never claim WIC-internal scratch, reservations, concurrent peak, same-process delta, codec advantage or product SLO.

Taskern packet; pinned Native source and two fresh repeats; eight finite Gates each within the 600s producer ceiling on one candidate digest; failed Gates retained; successful-only disposal with before/after native verify; commit, explicit dev:dev push and exact remote SHA before Tern; PASS0/0/0 then docs-only bounded disposition.

outputs.description: W12 PNG fixture, matched-raster oracle, six-case matrix, strict verifier, hermetic and semantic negative tests.
Two fresh six-case/twelve-lifetime real Windows records with JPEG/PNG ROI bytes, admission stages, decoder/format observations and whole-process windows.
Quality/regressions, eight committed-candidate Gates, artifact correspondence, successful-only disposal integrity, pushed Tern review and limited disposition.

acceptance.statement: A01/A02: both fixture structures, encoded bytes, digests, dimensions and depth are independently verified, and every JPEG and PNG input pixel equals the fixed DC/block-coordinate oracle; producer hashes alone never approve a fixture.
A03/A04/A05: all four normal ROI outputs reconstruct independently to RGBA; the JPEG/PNG pairs at 1x1 and 256x256 match exactly; both 4K inputs pass full-frame admission and reach OnLoad ROI output.
A06/A07/A08: S05 and S06 refuse before OnLoad on the 4095 dimension bound and publish no valid output; all twelve worker lifetimes keep consistent identity, trace and reaping.

A09/A10/A11: memory comparisons use the same after_onload boundary, remain OBSERVED_WHOLE_PROCESS_DIFFERENTIAL, are never promoted to WIC-internal or product memory facts, and two fresh repeats agree on deterministic fixtures/outputs/classification.
A12/A14/A15: strict W1-W11 regression is preserved, tampering, stale paths, missing evidence and inconsistent repeats fail closed, and portable replay is distinct from Git source closure.

A13 plus Gate exit: source identity matches real Git blobs and the Gate candidate, eight fresh Gates share one candidate digest, and commit, explicit dev push, exact remote-SHA confirmation precede the bounded Tern verdict.

evaluation.requirement: Hermetic/negative tests plus two real Windows matrices; independent JPEG/PNG parsing, all-pixel oracle, ROI equality, admission stages and whole-process windows.
Installed Taskern prepare, unchanged quality/W1-W11 regression, eight finite Gates within producer limits, integrity-bounded disposal, explicit push and remote SHA before a clean Tern verdict.
